## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #132, #133: "the first time you play each Automa-α/β (ζ) cost card, add the subsequent cost" is `watch_first_plays` over the ladder by cost ((0) → (4)). GPT II's choice of α or β is made as it is cast.

- #133 GPT III's Radiant face: "Add a Radiant Dagger & Flare" adds a Radiant Daglare (#133.1), the fusion of the two.

- #138, #139: once embiggened, the added cards have Tribute 1 (2). Before that, they keep their own.
